metadata.description: Scientific record and causal claim reconciliation for Post-BaseHTTP high-concurrency diagnosis
metadata.benchmark_execution: NO NEW BENCHMARK EXECUTION — REASONING EXCLUSIVELY FROM VERIFIED HISTORICAL EVIDENCE

c500_instrumentation_overhead.note: Only C100 pairwise overhead was recorded in post_basehttp_bottleneck_diagnosis.json. C500 overhead was not directly measured.

threadpool_capacity_audit.dimensional_error: Double division of worker service demand. 17.10 ms was already total demand per request across all 3 jobs.
threadpool_capacity_audit.empirical_refutation: Empirical C50 reached 543.0 RPS, disproving the claimed theoretical ceiling of 390 req/s.
threadpool_capacity_audit.classification: W/D CAPACITY ESTIMATE NOT SUFFICIENT FOR CAUSAL THROUGHPUT LIMIT.

pre_route_ms.name: PRE-ROUTE SERVER INTERVAL
components_included: Starlette URL routing and endpoint resolution
FastAPI request body reading and Pydantic validation
Asyncio event-loop runnable queueing and coroutine dispatch
pre_route_ms.isolation_status: Internal decomposition between execution and event-loop queueing not isolated.

pre_asgi_client_transport.name: PRE-ASGI CLIENT/TRANSPORT INTERVAL
pre_asgi_client_transport.physical_boundary: Between client task initiation (C1_post_start) and server ASGI entry (S0_asgi_entry)
pre_asgi_client_transport.isolation_status: Unattributed. Internal mechanisms (TCP handshake, kernel socket buffer, Uvicorn accept scheduling) not separately distinguished.

event_loop_heartbeat_audit.support: NO LARGE SYNCHRONOUS EVENT-LOOP BLOCKING STALLS OBSERVED
event_loop_heartbeat_audit.limitation: Zero lag is compatible with frequent coroutine yielding and does not independently prove event loop saturation.

cpu_attribution_audit.classification: Process CPU usage plateaus at approximately 1.1-1.2 logical-core equivalents across all process threads. Per-thread CPU was not directly measured.

risk_p99_statistical_reconciliation.distinction: Global stage p99 is the unconditional 99th percentile across all 1,000 risk worker calls. Regional p99-band mean is the mean risk worker service of the 15 slowest overall requests.

tail_latency_reconciliation.classification: TAIL EXPANSION IS DOMINATED BY SCHEDULING/REQUEST-LIFECYCLE INTERVALS RATHER THAN MODEL COMPUTE, BUT THE INTERNAL CAUSAL DECOMPOSITION OF THE LARGEST INTERVALS IS NOT FULLY ISOLATED.

causal_claims_matrix.claim: High-concurrency latency is reproducible
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Fresh canonical baseline reproduced historical baseline across all 6 tiers
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Cross-session operating system variance

causal_claims_matrix.claim: pre_route_ms is largest measured C500 latency region
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: None; directly measured between S0 and S8

causal_claims_matrix.claim: pre_route_ms is entirely asyncio runnable-queue waiting
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Traverses 8 middlewares, validation, routing; sub-intervals not isolated

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Async resume delays increase materially with concurrency
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Measured resume delay grows monotonically from 0.18 ms (C1) to 45 ms (C500) per job
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: None; directly measured between worker end and coroutine resume

causal_claims_matrix.claim: PyTorch is dominant latency source
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Offloaded to threadpool, uses OpenMP CPU threads
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Service time is only 2.77 ms at median; tail expands by only 0.22 ms

causal_claims_matrix.claim: FeatureStore is dominant latency source
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Lookup 1 offloaded, Lookup 2 nested in risk engine
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Total FS compute is <12 ms; queue wait is <3 ms at median

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Risk engine is dominant latency source
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Total risk compute is only 8.76 ms (3.0 ms pure heuristic compute)

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Executor burst saturation occurs
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Active workers reach max (20); queue depth reaches 96 at C500
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Queue drains between bursts; median queue wait is only 2.84 ms

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Executor is sole throughput bottleneck
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Active workers at max during bursts
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Median queue wait is <3 ms; theoretical pool capacity exceeds 1000 req/s

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Server process CPU plateaus around 1.1-1.2 core equivalents
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: psutil recorded 110.5%-119.7% across C10 to C500
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: None; directly measured at process level

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Event-loop thread itself is proven at exactly 100% CPU
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Per-thread CPU profiling was not directly measured

causal_claims_matrix.claim: GIL contention causes resume delays
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: No GIL profiler was executed; direct causal link unmeasured

causal_claims_matrix.claim: aiohttp client starvation occurs
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Client loop lag p99 <11 ms; client CPU <29%; /health reached 2021 RPS

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Response serialization materially limits throughput
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Model construction takes 0.04 ms; ASGI body send takes 0.24 ms

causal_claims_matrix.claim: GC materially limits throughput
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: RSS stable at ~490 MB; zero GC stop-the-world pauses

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Pre-ASGI interval is specifically TCP/socket backlog
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: 142.84 ms measured between client dispatch and ASGI entry
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Internal socket/kernel/Uvicorn accept queue mechanisms not isolated

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Tail expansion is dominated by non-model request-lifecycle intervals
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: pre_route_ms (+401 ms) and pre-ASGI (+116 ms) account for 91% of delta
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: None; PyTorch forward expands by only 0.22 ms

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Single Uvicorn worker is unique causal throughput bottleneck
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Workload involves 3 thread offloads; multi-worker counterfactual not run

causal_claims_matrix.claim: One dominant throughput bottleneck has been established
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Interacting constraints (event loop, thread offloads, CPU) coexist

causal_claims_matrix.claim: Multiple interacting constraints are more consistent with evidence
causal_claims_matrix.existing_evidence: Event-loop duty cycle, thread offloading, and burst queueing interact
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Hypothesized joint causal bottleneck not counterfactually isolated
causal_claims_matrix.classification: CONSISTENT WITH EVIDENCE / PLAUSIBLE MULTI-CONSTRAINT EXPLANATION

causal_claims_matrix.claim: C500 latency is sufficiently localized for research closure
causal_claims_matrix.limitation: Sub-intervals of pre_route not isolated, but sufficient for portfolio E scope

research_backlog_closure.rationale: High-concurrency latency has been reproducibly demonstrated and localized to concurrency-sensitive request-lifecycle/scheduling intervals rather than algorithmic model compute. The dominant measured region is pre-route server time, with additional coroutine-resume and pre-ASGI client/transport delay. Exact causal subdivision of those broad intervals is not fully isolated, but this residual uncertainty does not prevent closure of the original research question.

intervention_readiness.status: F. CURRENT PERFORMANCE SUFFICIENTLY CHARACTERIZED FOR RESEARCH-BACKLOG CLOSURE WITHOUT NEED FOR FURTHER OPTIMIZATION
